property_summary: For every call to transfer, the reference contract reverts when the _tos array is empty (i.e. transfer(...) does not complete successfully for empty _tos), whereas the mutant allows empty _tos and returns true; the property: transfer(...) must revert for any empty _tos input and the mutant violates this.
change_summary: Change the require that enforces non-empty _tos to a no-op (deleted), allowing calls with empty _tos which will return true instead of reverting.
